chronology_basis: Successful GitHub branch CAS was observed before launching the test child; remote commit metadata was independently fetched after launch. Git metadata and the local run receipt are not an external cryptographic timestamp attestation.
later_timing_registration_scope: The timing runner creates its local registration after the main test is complete. Its literal test_outcomes_materialized_before_registration=false only describes that timing invocation before it materializes its own cohort/output; it is not evidence that all test outcomes were globally unseen.
